title.zh: 将宿务省 Sibonga 市镇 Sibonga 国立中学附属校从该校分离并改设为名为 Julian Enad 国立中学的独立国立中学并拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Sibonga National High School Extension in the Municipality of Sibonga, Province of Cebu, From the Sibonga National High School and Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as the Julian Enad National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Sibonga National High School Extension in the Municipality of Sibonga, Province of Cebu, From the Sibonga National High School and Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as the Julian Enad National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1998/ra_8739_1998.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Sibonga National High School Extension in Barangay Lamacan, Municipality of Sibonga, Province of Cebu, is hereby separated from the Sibonga National High School in the Municipality of Sibonga and converted into an independent national high school to be known as the Julian Enad National High School.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act.
All personnel, assets and liabilities and records of the Sibonga National High School Extension are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Julian Enad National High School.

The amount necessary for the implementation of this Act shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Sibonga National High School-Lamacan Annex. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for the operation and maintenance of the Julian Enad National High School shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: September 17, 1998
